one_liner: Cloudflare has a broad REST API with self-serve API tokens and OAuth clients, plus an official MCP server covering the full API.
auth_notes: OAuth clients (authorization_code) can be created in the dashboard or via API. API tokens (user or account-owned) are the documented main method. Legacy Global API Key via X-Auth-Email/X-Auth-Key also works. The OAuth client docs are fairly new and may be limited to certain scopes.
access_notes: A free Cloudflare account can create API tokens and OAuth clients. Some features, such as API Shield and the Tenant/Partner APIs, need Enterprise or partner agreements, but the core API doesn't.
blocker_notes: Nothing blocks a toolkit. Users need appropriate roles to create OAuth clients or tokens, and some endpoints depend on plan.

evidence.quote: To create OAuth clients with the Cloudflare API, create an API token with the `OAuth Clients Write` permission.
